description: List S3 object keys under a bucket/prefix as a Dagster asset -- mirrors Airflow's S3ListOperator.

outputs.description: keys (List[str]), common_prefixes (List[str], only with delimiter set), count (int).

prefix.label: Prefix
prefix.description: Only list keys starting with this prefix.

delimiter.label: Delimiter
delimiter.description: Group keys by this delimiter (e.g. '/'): only keys immediately under prefix are returned as keys, and one level of subfolder names is returned separately as common_prefixes.

resource_key.label: Resource Key
resource_key.description: Optional key of a registered aws_s3_resource (resources/aws_s3_resource). When set, credentials/session come from that resource instead of a bare boto3.client('s3', region_name=...).

deps.description: Lineage-only upstream asset keys (no data passed at runtime).
deps.label: Deps

owners.description: Asset owners — team names (team:analytics) or email addresses.
owners.label: Owners

asset_tags.description: Key-value tags applied to the asset in the Dagster catalog, e.g. {"domain": "finance"}.
asset_tags.label: Asset Tags

kinds.description: Asset kinds shown in the Dagster catalog (e.g. snowflake, python). Auto-inferred from component name if empty.
kinds.label: Kinds

name: S3ListKeysAsset
